# @boostengine/server — Full API Manifest (v1.1.0)

`@boostengine/server` is the universal backend router and headless API layer for
the BoostEngine ecosystem. It auto-mounts payment, cart, auth, shipping,
coupons, returns, and invoicing endpoints across Express, Fastify, and Hono.

---

## 1. Configuration

```ts
interface BoostServerConfig {
  razorpayKeyId?: string;
  razorpayKeySecret?: string;
  shiprocketEmail?: string;
  shiprocketPassword?: string;
  fast2smsApiKey?: string;
  gstNumber?: string;
  businessName?: string;
  mockMode?: boolean;                          // default true
  webhookSecrets?: Partial<Record<WebhookProvider, string>>;
  enable?: {
    payments?: boolean;
    shipping?: boolean;
    auth?: boolean;
    cart?: boolean;
    coupons?: boolean;
    returns?: boolean;
    invoicing?: boolean;
    notifications?: boolean;
  };
  middleware?: BoostMiddleware[];
  prefix?: string;                             // default ''
  [key: string]: any;
}
```

`BoostMiddleware = (req: any, res: any, next: (err?: any) => void) => void`.

---

## 2. Adapters

### Express (`@boostengine/server`)

```ts
createBoostRouter(config?: BoostServerConfig): Router;
createBoostApiRouter; // alias
```

```ts
import express from 'express';
import { createBoostRouter } from '@boostengine/server';
const app = express();
app.use(express.json());
app.use('/api', createBoostRouter({ businessName: 'My Store' }));
```

### Fastify (`@boostengine/server/fastify`)

```ts
boostFastifyPlugin(fastify: any, options?: BoostServerConfig, done?: (err?: Error) => void): void;
```

```ts
import Fastify from 'fastify';
import { boostFastifyPlugin } from '@boostengine/server/fastify';
const fastify = Fastify();
fastify.register(boostFastifyPlugin, { businessName: 'My Store' });
```

### Hono (`@boostengine/server/hono`)

```ts
boostHonoMiddleware(app: any, config?: BoostServerConfig): void;
```

```ts
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import { boostHonoMiddleware } from '@boostengine/server/hono';
const app = new Hono();
boostHonoMiddleware(app, { businessName: 'My Store' });
export default app;
```

---

## 3. Framework-agnostic route table

```ts
interface RouteRequest {
  params: Record<string, string>;
  query: Record<string, string>;
  body: any;
  headers: Record<string, string>;
}
interface RouteResult { status: number; body: any; }
interface RouteDefinition {
  method: HttpMethod;
  path: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  handler: (req: RouteRequest) => RouteResult | Promise<RouteResult>;
}

buildRouteDefinitions(config?: BoostServerConfig): RouteDefinition[];
```

### Mounted routes (default, all modules enabled)

- `POST /payments/create-order`, `/payments/verify`, `/payments/webhook`
- `GET /shipping/pincode/:pincode`, `POST /shipping/check-pincode`, `POST /shipping/create-shipment`, `GET /shipping/track/:awb`
- `POST /auth/send-otp`, `/auth/verify-otp`
- `GET /cart`, `POST /cart/add`, `PUT /cart/update`, `DELETE /cart/remove/:itemId`, `DELETE /cart/clear`
- `POST /coupons/validate`, `/coupons/apply`
- `POST /returns/initiate`, `GET /returns/status/:returnId`
- `POST /invoicing/generate`
- `POST /notifications/whatsapp`, `/notifications/email`, `/notifications/sms`
- `GET /health`, `GET /ping`

---

## 4. Webhook signature verification

```ts
type WebhookProvider =
  | 'razorpay' | 'cashfree' | 'phonepe' | 'paytm' | 'stripe' | 'shiprocket';

interface WebhookVerifyOptions {
  timestamp?: string;   // epoch string for Cashfree/PhonePe
  saltIndex?: string;   // PhonePe salt index
}

verifyWebhookSignature(provider, payload, signature, secret, options?): boolean;
signWebhookPayload(provider, payload, secret, options?): string;
generateWebhookPayload(provider, event): Record<string, any>;
```

Algorithm per provider (constant-time compare):
- `razorpay` — hex HMAC-SHA256(rawBody).
- `stripe` — `t=<ts>,v1=<sig>`; `v1 = HMAC-SHA256(secret, ts + "." + body)`.
- `cashfree` — base64 HMAC-SHA256(`timestamp + body`).
- `phonepe` — hex HMAC-SHA256(`body + "###" + saltIndex`).
- `paytm` / `shiprocket` — hex HMAC-SHA256(rawBody).

---

## 5. Middleware primitives

```ts
errorHandler(err, req, res, next): void;
// -> res.status(err.status || 500).json({ success: false, error: msg, code? })

createIdempotencyHandler(options?: {
  store?: Map<string, any>;
  keyHeader?: string;          // default 'idempotency-key'
  duplicateStatus?: number;    // default 409
}): BoostMiddleware;

createRateLimiter(options?: {
  windowMs?: number;           // default 60_000
  max?: number;                // default 100
  store?: Map<string, number[]>;
}): BoostMiddleware;
```

---

## 6. AI Agent Toolkit (`@boostengine/server/ai`)

```ts
interface ToolDefinition {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  parameters: JsonSchema;
  execute?(args: Record<string, any>, context?: ToolContext): any | Promise<any>;
}

serverTools: ToolDefinition[];
createServerTools(config?): ToolDefinition[];
toOpenAITools(tools);   // OpenAI function-calling schema
toAnthropicTools(tools); // Anthropic tools schema
toMCPTools(tools);       // MCP tools/list payload
getServerSystemPrompt(): string;
generateServerBoilerplate(framework, config?): string;
```

Core tools:
1. `inspect_server_routes` — list mounted routes (method, path, name).
2. `generate_webhook_payload` — mock webhook event payload.
3. `verify_webhook_signature_tool` — verify/debug webhook signatures.
4. `generate_server_boilerplate` — Express/Fastify/Hono server scaffold.

---

## 7. Dependency integration

Seamlessly pairs with `@boostengine/core`, `@boostengine/payments`,
`@boostengine/auth`, `@boostengine/shipping`, `@boostengine/invoicing`,
`@boostengine/returns`, `@boostengine/cart`, and `@boostengine/coupons`. The
server routes run in mock/simulation mode until real credentials are supplied
in `BoostServerConfig`.
